parsed.headline: Denied: Insulin Administration Requirement Not Met for CGM Coverage
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because it does not meet the requirement: "The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,". The record shows fewer than three daily insulin injections and no Medicare-covered CSII pump.
parsed.what_to_do: No action needed unless documentation can show three or more daily insulin injections or a Medicare-covered CSII pump.
